# LUD-04

## Summary

LNURL-withdraw specification. Cashback and withdrawal via Lightning.

`author: fiatjaf`

[LUD-0](0.md)
[LUD-1](1.md)

## Specification

LNURL-withdraw allows users to receive Lightning payments by scanning QR codes.
The flow:

1. Merchant displays LNURL-withdraw QR
2. User scans with wallet
3. Wallet fetches the LNURL endpoint
4. Server returns invoice to pay
5. Merchant pays the invoice to user

## Use Cases

- Cashback systems
- Withdrawal from exchanges
- Loyalty programs
